name: Advantage Given to/Used for Someone Else
action: after event is logged, a prompt will pop up asking what the advantage was (remove this advantage from the survivor advantages). It will then ask if the advantage was given or used. If it was given, a survivor needs to be chosen and that advantage added to their advantages).
